{{Quote|Talismans of Transformation allow the wearer to change shape in the physical realm, to become an animal and tap into the animal's spirit essence, for example.|[[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]|<ref name="BoSSotDS" />}}
The '''Talismans of Transformation''' were [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] artifacts used by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. They allowed their wearer to [[Metamorphosis|take the shape]] of another creature.

==Properties==
The Talismans of Transformation were crafted on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] by the [[Shaman of the Nightsisters|Shamans]] of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. Those talismans possessed strange arcane powers that both [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Lore Keeper|Jedi scholars]] could not fully explain. In the form of gems set in rings or pendants, they allowed the wearer to [[Metamorphosis|take the appearance]] of an animal. They were thought to work through the power of the [[Spirit (Nightsisters)|"Spirits"]], which probably were a mythological embodiment of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] culture. According to [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], the Spirits agreed to empower receptacles in the physical world, where their essence would sleep until summoned.<ref name="BoSSotDS" />

==History==
The magic [[Ring/Legends|ring]] of [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|Sister]] [[Charal]], the self-proclaimed [[Witch-Queen]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], was in fact one of these devices,<ref name="TBFE">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref> known as the [[Talisman of the Raven]].<ref name="BoSSotDS" /> Charal had probably stolen the ring when she abandoned her clan over a [[Standard century/Legends|standard century]] before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> At the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when Mother Talzin wrote her instructional manual ''[[Wild Power]]'', she mentioned this missing talisman.<ref name="BoSSotDS" />

When [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] came in possession of Talzin's manual, he remarked that those talismans did not seem very different from [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulets]], yet none of their abilities had been successfully duplicated by a [[Sith alchemist/Legends|Sith alchemist]].<ref name="BoSSotDS" />
